title: Taku AI
description_en: Borrow the best AI setups and make them yours.. AI is getting insanely powerful — and somehow harder to use. Taku fixes the last mile. It turns the best skills, agents, and workflows into real desktop apps anyone can run, remix, and make their own. Borrow setups from the pros, skip GitHub and setup, or just tell Taku what you want and watch it assemble the stack. The more you work, the more Taku learns what you need — and brings the right tools to you.
description_zh: Taku AI解决的核心问题是AI工具配置门槛过高的'最后一公里'难题。产品将复杂的AI技能、Agent和工作流封装成可直接运行的桌面应用，用户无需接触GitHub或复杂配置即可使用。核心机制是：①用户可以直接借用（borrow）专业人士已验证的AI配置 ②通过自然语言描述需求，Taku自动组装技术栈 ③系统会学习用户工作模式，主动推荐合适工具。目标用户是需要AI能力但缺乏技术背景的知识工作者。已获得383票PH支持，显示市场对降低AI使用门槛有强烈需求，4.0评分证明产品体验获得初步认可。

title: Salem Robotics
description_en: Deploy autonomous robots for surveys and manipulation tasks. Robot software brain for autonomous surveys, inspections, and manipulation in hazardous facilities. Instead of sending technicians in with handheld detectors and clipboards, an operator draws the route on a dashboard. The robot navigates, opens doors, turns valves, takes measurements, and returns a compliance-ready report with heatmaps and flagged risks. Hardware-agnostic, built on published research by PhD roboticists with a decade at Los Alamos. Deploy on your robot, or we provide one with it.
description_zh: Salem Robotics开发用于危险设施（核电站、化工厂等）的自主机器人系统。核心产品是硬件无关的机器人软件大脑，使机器人能够自主完成巡检、测量、开门、转阀门等任务。工作流程：操作员在仪表盘上画出路线，机器人自主导航执行任务，自动生成带热力图和风险标记的合规报告。技术基于发表的学术研究，团队来自Los Alamos国家实验室，有十年机器人研发经验。可部署在客户现有机器人上，或提供整套硬件解决方案。目标用户是核电、石化等需要定期巡检但环境危险的工业设施。Product Hunt仅77票显示市场认知度低，但这类B2B工业产品本就不依赖消费者曝光。

description_en: A persistent terminal for Codex and Claude side by side. Run coding agents across tabs, panes, and remote machines. title: Controller AI

full_profile.biz_model_zh: 推测采用SaaS订阅模式，可能按对话量/会议预约数/集成CRM数量分层定价。用户付费逻辑是：①节省SDR人力成本（美国SDR年薪$6-8万）②提高响应速度（实时vs数小时/天）③7x24覆盖全球时区。与竞品Drift/Intercom的差异在于更聚焦销售转化而非客服，但这个定位的护城河较弱——Intercom等已有类似功能，且大量AI chatbot工具都在做销售场景。缺乏定价信息和客户案例，无法判断是否已有稳定付费用户。
full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角：这是一个典型的AI应用层产品，处于极度拥挤的赛道。市场被低估的可能性很小——Drift($1B+估值)、Qualified、11x.ai等已深耕多年，且OpenAI/Anthropic的API让技术门槛持续降低。Alpha机会微弱，除非团队有：①独特的垂直行业数据(如只做医疗/金融)②极致的对话转化率(>行业3-5倍)③被大平台收购的战略价值。主要风险：同质化严重、大厂降维打击(HubSpot/Salesforce自建)、ROI难证明导致续费率低。印度团队背景未知，可能在成本控制上有优势但缺乏硅谷销售网络。这更像是一个执行层面的机会而非结构性Alpha。

title: GxP-Agent: Process-DAG Topology for Reliable Clinical Trial Programming with LLM Agents

We introduce GxP-Agent, a multi-agent system that encodes regulatory process ordering as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), decomposing monolithic dataset generation into 15 domain-specific nodes executed by worker agents with pharmaverse skill context, validation gates, and conditional retry. On CDISC-Bench, a new execution-based benchmark built from the FDA pilot submission CDISCPilot01 (254 subjects, 49 ground-tru
description_zh: GxP-Agent针对临床试验编程这一监管提交瓶颈问题：将研究协议转化为符合CDISC标准的分析数据集。现有LLM单次生成在此任务上完全失败（5个前沿模型11次尝试无一成功生成有效的受试者级分析数据集）。该系统创新性地将监管流程编码为有向无环图(DAG)，把单体数据集生成分解为15个领域特定节点，由配备pharmaverse技能上下文、验证门和条件重试机制的worker agents执行。在新构建的CDISC-Bench基准测试（基于FDA试点提交CDISCPilot01，包含254名受试者和49个ground-truth数据点）上进行评估。这是一个高度专业化的垂直领域AI应用，解决制药行业真实痛点，但目前仅为学术研究阶段。

full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角：这是一个典型的'极小众但高价值'垂直场景——临床试验数据标准化是制药行业的真实痛点，市场规模虽小但客单价极高，且几乎无人愿意深耕这个需要同时懂AI、监管和CDISC标准的交叉领域。Alpha在于：①技术壁垒极高（需要pharmaverse领域知识+多Agent协作）；②监管护城河（GxP合规要求阻挡通用AI工具）；③明确的Exit路径（被Veeva、IQVIA等临床数据巨头收购）。风险：①纯学术项目，无团队无商业化计划；②市场教育成本高，制药公司决策周期长；③需要大量真实临床数据训练和验证才能商用。若有experienced团队将此商业化，可能是隐藏的Alpha机会。
full_profile.score_narrative_zh: AI Native得14分：虽然采用多Agent架构和DAG工作流，但本质是将传统编程流程用Agent执行，未形成数据飞轮，且仍依赖规则化验证而非自进化。Niche得18分：临床试验CDISC标准化是极小众方向，pharmaverse技能上下文构成一定壁垒，但作为学术项目技术可复制性存疑。商业模式得6分：纯论文阶段无任何商业化迹象，潜在市场存在但路径不明。团队得0分：arXiv论文无作者信息，无法评估团队背景。加7分：极小众结构化机会+3，解决真实行业痛点有benchmark验证+4。减3分：信息严重不足（无团队、无产品、无用户）-3。总分42分反映了'技术方向有价值但商业化为零'的现状。

title: Claude Watermark
description_en: Find and remove every trace AI leaves in your text. Paste any text and see every trace a chat interface left in it: hidden HTML class names, zero-width characters, exotic spaces, typography. Each finding has a count and a position, because these are facts about the bytes, not a probability score. Clean it in one click. Free, unlimited, no account, runs in your browser so nothing is uploaded. It does not claim to detect Anthropic's statistical watermark, because nobody outside Anthropic can. The engine is MIT open source.

title: ChatGPT for Teens
description_en: ChatGPT, built differently for teens. ChatGPT for Teens is a dedicated ChatGPT experience for ages 13–17, designed around how teens learn and use AI. It encourages working through problems instead of simply giving homework answers, with Study Mode, quizzes, learning visualizations, and Study Hours. Stronger safety protections and healthy-use features are built in by default, with optional parental controls—while keeping teens' conversations private.

full_profile.overview_zh: 这是OpenAI官方针对13-17岁青少年群体推出的ChatGPT定制版本。核心设计理念是引导青少年通过思考解决问题,而非直接提供作业答案。产品包含Study Mode(学习模式)、测验功能、学习可视化工具和Study Hours(学习时段管理)。默认内置更强的安全保护机制和健康使用功能,提供可选的家长控制选项,同时保证青少年对话的隐私性。目标用户是13-17岁学生及其家长。已有824条评论,评分4.98/5,显示用户满意度极高。这是OpenAI在教育垂直领域的战略布局,Sam Altman作为maker直接参与。
full_profile.biz_model_zh: 商业模式信息严重不足。推测可能采用以下方式:①作为ChatGPT Plus的家庭订阅附加服务;②独立订阅模式(月费$10-20);③通过学校机构批量授权。OpenAI的教育战略可能是先建立用户习惯和品牌忠诚度,再通过订阅或机构合作变现。与竞品(如Khan Academy的Khanmigo)相比,OpenAI拥有最强的模型能力和品牌认知,但教育场景的商业化路径尚不明确。缺乏具体定价和付费转化数据是重大减分项。
full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角:这是OpenAI的防御性产品而非Alpha机会。①方向价值:青少年AI教育是万亿级市场,但OpenAI此举更多是应对监管压力和竞争(Google/Microsoft都在做教育AI),而非创新突破。②市场被低估之处:几乎没有——这是显而易见的大赛道,巨头必争之地。③风险:OpenAI作为平台方,会压制所有教育AI创业公司的生存空间;产品本质是ChatGPT的功能限制版,技术壁垒为零。④投资论文不适配:我们寻找的是非共识的Agent创新,而非巨头的渠道下沉产品。这个产品证明教育AI赛道已被巨头占领,我们应该寻找更Niche的结构性机会。
full_profile.score_narrative_zh: AI Native得12分:虽然基于GPT-4强大能力,但产品设计是传统的'功能限制+内容过滤',并非真正的AI-native创新。Study Mode本质是prompt engineering,没有专门为青少年学习优化的模型或数据飞轮。Niche得8分:青少年教育看似垂直,实则是最拥挤的赛道,OpenAI/Google/Khan Academy全在做,同质化严重,无差异化壁垒。商业模式得6分:完全不清晰,可能依赖OpenAI主产品的订阅收入,无独立变现证据。团队得9分:Sam Altman背书加3分,但这更像是OpenAI的战略防御项目而非创始团队的创业激情。加分3分:OpenAI官方产品+Sam Altman maker+高用户评分(4.98)证明产品质量,但PH仅0票说明发布策略有问题或数据未更新。无减分项但整体缺乏Alpha信号。

title: Superflow AI
description_en: AI agents that QA your website before launch. Superflow turns the QA checklist you already use into a team of AI agents. They sweep every page, desktop and mobile, and pin every finding on the live site. Agents handle the black and white issues. Taste stays with you. Agents learn: rejected findings stop coming back, and misses become checks on future sites. Teams say they catch ~90% of what they found by hand. Works with Webflow, Framer, WordPress, Shopify, Next.js, Netlify + more.

title: Hubble
description_en: Retrieve medical records other APIs can't. Medical records still live behind fax lines, phone trees, and portal logins nobody remembers. A patient verifies their identity once, and Hubble assembles their records from across their providers and returns them through one API, for your AI agent to use.

title: Gauge
description_en: Agent Led Growth: Get written into every customer's codebase. Don’t use Gauge. Unless you want your tool to get written into every codebase. Agents are leading the next wave of growth for our customers including Supabase, Openrouter, Resend, PostHog, Mintlify, Braintrust, and more. Unlike AI chat, coding agents are implementing products autonomously. They're doing so without ever talking to a sales rep or taking a demo. Gauge runs real coding sessions to identify actions to improve the agent’s preference, and the agent experience once you’re selected.

title: Deepmark
description_en: Search your bookmarks by what's inside them, not the title. Your browser bookmarks, X bookmarks, Instagram saves and YouTube Watch Later, in one private library you can search in plain language. Deepmark reads every page, transcribes videos and reels, describes and OCRs frames, then embeds it all. 'The reel with the one-pan pasta trick' finds the reel even though nothing in it says pasta. A save is searchable in about 90 seconds; search over 10k items returns in under 100ms. Also a hosted MCP server: your AI agent can search your library too.

title: CrewTower
description_en: Control your agents from the notch. Crew Tower lives in your MacBook notch and watches every AI coding agent you run: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Qwen, OpenCode and more. When an agent needs permission, the request shows up in the notch with full context: the exact command, the file edit, the question. Approve or deny in one click, without touching the terminal. See every session at once, working, waiting or done. Jump straight to the right terminal window when one needs you. Nothing stalls silently.

title: Meterless.ai
description_en: Run AI locally and own the whole workflow. Most AI tools return an answer and discard the process. Meterless lets the real workflow run on your device—and makes it yours. Relay turns desktop work into reusable missions. Gaia keeps projects, memory, and context persistent. Swarms exposes the full agent graph. Replay, edit, switch models, and run the work again without starting over. Local-first, model-agnostic, and built so AI work compounds instead of disappearing.

title: Whisperstream
description_en: Local AI dictation for Windows. Local AI dictation for Windows. Push-to-talk hotkey, words paste into any window, transcription runs on your CPU so audio never leaves your machine. No cloud, no model trained on your voice. $29 one-time, no subscription. Free trial, no account.

title: The AI Platform
description_en: Maximizing Human Potential. The AI Platform is a provider-agnostic AI superapp for multi-agent, multi-human organizations. Work with friends or coworkers, bring your own mini app and share it with the world.

title: Origin by Cursor
description_en: The Git forge built for the age of coding agents. Origin is Cursor's new code hosting platform, built for a world where humans and coding agents work side by side. Create and host Git repos directly in Cursor, browse and search code, open and review pull requests, manage access, and sync with GitHub. Your code now lives next to the agents working on it—with more agent-native features on the way.

title: Vois 2.0
description_en: The ElevenLabs alternative with unlimited generation. An ElevenLabs alternative on your desktop. Subscriptions get unlimited text to speech: no tokens, no usage meter, no per-character fees. 100+ voices, voice cloning with consent built in, a multi-speaker timeline, mastering, export, and a CLI your AI agents can drive. 23 languages, 600+ with Omni on Pro. Used for audiobooks, podcasts, faceless YouTube videos, game NPC voices, tutorials, and courses, by makers at companies you would recognize. Launch: $10/mo for the life of your subscription.

title: Sider 6.0
description_en: Your AI Agent for the Browser. Sider AI 6.0 introduces Wisebase for unlimited document Q&A and auto-building an AI knowledge base, Claw for automating multi-page browser tasks, and Code for instantly customizing any website with AI — no coding needed, changes persist. Available on Chrome, Edge, iOS, Android & Desktop.
